svg.title: Data prediction and noise prediction are equivalent conditional means
svg.desc: For the same Gaussian mixture prior and fixed noisy observation x_t=0.35, alpha=0.55, sigma=0.8351646544245033, analytic posteriors over x_0 and epsilon are related by epsilon=(x_t-alpha*x_0)/sigma. Dashed lines mark the posterior means D*=0.929138 and epsilon*=-0.192807, not samples. Both recover the same score 0.230862.
